title: v2 agent heartbeat payload
description: The `payload` object of a POST /api/v2/products/{product}/telemetry with measurement_type=agent_status

machine_id.description: Windows MachineGuid, or the all-zero GUID if unreadable

agent_version.description: contents of the repo VERSION file, compiled in

channel.description: compiled-in release channel; feeds the beta->stable promotion gate in specs/001

instrument_software.description: the instrument control-software (Luminosa / Solira) version, from two independent sources (FR-004a); each may be null

version.description: file-version resource of <install_dir>\<Product>.exe — the version installed now

log_version.description: version stamped in the header of the newest *.pqlog — the version that last ran

ok.description: true if the cycle completed without an internal error

last_failure_category.description: the most recent submission-failure category this cycle, or null if the cycle had no failures (FR-002f, FR-027)

blocked_backups.description: watched files that could not be backed up this cycle (FR-007)

last_backup_days.description: optional freshness hint: file_key -> YYYY-MM-DD of last successful backup
